Name: Portrait Expansion for modding Events and Dialog
Author: TheDuckModder
Description:
[u][size=3]Portrait Expansion for modding Events and Dialog ![/size][/u]

[list]
[*]Adds 506 unique portraits for a total of 1233 portraits accross every NPCs to the base game !
[/list]
[list]
[*]This mod is here to help you create content with[i] new and nuanced emotions[/i] to NPCs. 
[/list] ﻿Some are these portraits are closer to ConcernedApe's and others are more origianal allowing a new take on NPCs and their personalities !

[list]
[*]I also added a 'Stainless' versions of Gus's and George's portraits (removing stains from George's wheelchair and Gus's jacket) in the files for you to replace if you'd like to give some consideration to good ol' George !
[/list]
[list]
[*]If you'd like to create portraits yourself, I included certain elements of portraits such as hands arms or other elements allowing mixing and matching elements to your liking without having to outline the element first. Feel free to expand upon this expansion !
[/list]
[list]
[*]Make sure you don't already have other portraits mods installed to avoid an error ! Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url] for pointing that out !
[/list]
Wether you want to create content that stays true to the spirit of stardew or create something different, this expansion is yours to use !
 

[u][size=3]TO USE THIS CONTENT FOR YOUR MODS[/size]

[/u]If you'd like to use these portraits to publish a mod, awesome !

Please add [i]Portrait Expansion[/i] to the [i]required mods [/i]section when publishing your mod making downloading this mod well... A requirement !
Thank you for respecting that condition and have fun creating !

Duck

Manifest.Name: Portraits Expansion
Manifest.Description: Adds a bunch of new portraits for modders to use for new and nuanced emotions during envents or dialog.
Manifest.Author: TheDuckmodder
